description.zh: 模糊搜索关键词。仅支持实体的name字段，且大小写不敏感
description.en: A keyword for a case-insensitive fuzzy search on the entity's `name` field.

description.zh: 利用实体的labels字段进行筛选。精确匹配labelSelector数组中的所有条件，不同条件之间是“且”的关系
description.en: Filters the list by the `labels` field of each entity. All conditions in the array must match (logical AND).

description.zh: 当前页码，默认为1。页码从1开始。
description.en: The page number. Pages are 1-indexed. The default is 1.

description.zh: 每页大小，默认为100。取值范围1~100
description.en: The number of entries per page. The default value is 100. Valid values: 1 to 100.
